{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
# But we found 0 such rows — so no removal needed

# Remove refunded orders
filtered_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
filtered_df['revenue'] = filtered_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining sentinel values in revenue
print(f'Any revenue values >= 100000? {filtered_df[filtered_df["revenue"] >= 100000].shape[0]}')

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print('\nCustomer segment by channel:')
print(filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))

# Check conversion rates by channel (raw)
channel_conv = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nRaw conversion rate by channel:')
print(channel_conv)

# Check conversion rate by segment
segment_conv = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by customer segment:')
print(segment_conv)"}
